proposal: D bootstrap model and training contract

inputs.features: int32 array [rows, fields] using global feature indexes
inputs.user_ids: ordered string array [rows], required for BPR only

outputs.predict_scores: finite float array [rows], same order as input
outputs.checkpoint: NPZ without pickle containing V, W, b, Adam state, step and JSON metadata

bpr.sampling_unit: positive and negative impressions from the same user
failure_conditions: no user has both positive and negative rows
risks: uniform negative sampling may overweight users with many positives
BPR aligns more directly with GAUC than nDCG@5
pair count and eligible-user coverage must be logged

resources.expected_memory: FM parameters plus one sampled pair-index array; exact size depends on encoded dimension

handoff_to_B.runner_responsibility: B owns the valid-only experiment CLI and artifact manifest
